# Has anyone taken on an abandoned addon?
I used to use what I would imagine is a simple addon but made a big QOL improvement. It was abandoned in 8.x the licence is “Public Domain” so hopefully there is no issue there
If I wanted to take it in I’m guessing I just clone the existing repository, try and fix the addon based on two expansions worth of changes and then uploaded it to curseforge as addon2.0.
While I’m trying to work out the kinks I’m assuming I can just make the code changes direct in the right WTF folder until it works and then upload to curseforge when I’m done? Do I need to sign or similar any addon while I’m developing it?
